# Precedent Transaction Screener

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. Past deal multiples describe what buyers paid under past conditions, not what a target is worth today: a precedent set built on a different credit cycle can anchor a bid badly wrong, there is a real risk of loss in any transaction, and no range here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: the precedent transaction screener skill at the root of andreworia/claude-finance-skills. Distinct from the precedent transactions skill of the investment banking pack (lot 86): this screener is built around screening discipline, cycle and structure adjustments and synergy calibration, and its governing principle is that a precedent is only useful if you would redo the deal at the same multiple today, otherwise adjust it or discard it. Use it when building the precedent page of a valuation deck, pressure testing a control premium thesis, or framing a buy-side bid against historical comparables. Every precedent in the final set must pass five filters with explicit justification on borderline cases: business comparability, scale comparability, geography and regulatory comparability, deal structure comparability, and cycle comparability; one missed filter makes a footnote, two make noise.
